name: PreprocessResult
signature: public sealed record PreprocessResult(string Text, int Version, bool IsEs, IReadOnlyList<string> Extensions, IReadOnlyList<string> Pragmas, IReadOnlyList<MacroDefinition> Defines, IReadOnlyList<string> IncludedFiles)

docs.summary: The output of the preprocessor. `Text` is GLSL with no directives left: macros are expanded, inactive `#if` blocks are removed, and each `#include` is replaced by its file's contents. The version, extensions, pragmas, and macros are the state the preprocessor found; `IncludedFiles` lists the files entered, in order.
